name: Halloween Words
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Words is a Halloween-themed word game. Every level has a new-spooky inspired background that you can enjoy while you play. From pirates to Jack O’ Lanterns, there is everything Halloween-y with complimenting colors of orange and black. This is a word game for our dictionary loving players who happy to like education as well as Halloween. Exercise your mind by scanning through the available letters to put together English words. There are 10 levels for you to solve before the timer runs out! Put together as many words as you can find to earn points and to reach your goal. Once you’ve solved all 10 levels, head over to the high scores to see how you rank against other word game players.
